notes.text: The exact narrative has the small son guarding his father’s bier. This passage does not give age five explicitly. Keep the received report and check the lead-in.
The checked narration gives thirteen people appointed for the Angel of Death in Yose’s stead and twenty-two years added to teach the child. The received phrase "given on your account" is elliptical.
The checked Zohar gives twelve years before he may disclose. Preserve Heilprin’s thirteen as the received reading.
The directly checked Zohar gives 365 tears. This is distinct from both 370 and the alternative 305 in the pinned Heilprin witness. The checked 300,000 benches agree with the received figure.
The checked digital transcription labels the voice’s paragraph folio 205a. Retain the legacy locator and verify any alternative pagination before normalization.
The raven cries as the party walks and Elazar interprets its call. The earlier dove belongs to a different scene.
The child quotes the core of Deuteronomy 22:7 to plead for his father. The biblical verse is exact.
The voice and both numbers appear in the checked narrative. The 205a page marker in the parallel transcription and the inherited locator are recorded separately.
The Zohar explicitly names the Angel of Death as recipient of the thirteen people given on Yose’s account. The Hebrew here leaves the recipient implicit.
The checked scene has a young son and gives no age in this passage. Retain the specific received age with that qualification.
The digital parallel gives twelve years. Keep Heilprin’s thirteen as received and distinguish it from the separate thirteen people and twenty-two added years.
The received 370 and its alternative 305 differ from the parallel 365. The 300,000 benches are a separate figure attested in the parallel.
